articles.title: Agent Coulson Actor Teases Link to Just-Announced Marvel TV Show, Zodiac
articles.summary: Agents of SHIELD star Clark Gregg, most famous for playing Agent Phil Coulson in the first Avengers movie, has teased his involvement with the just-announced Marvel TV show, Zodiac.
body: Marvel announced Zodiac at a New York Comic Con panel yesterday with a logo, below, a 2028 release window, and little else. We know it's a spy thriller and, based on the logo, it has something to do with SHIELD. Hot on the heels of the reveal, Gregg shared the announcement to his Instagram, sparking speculation that the two shows are linked.
The logo for the show features the show’s title, Zodiac, with a stylized “o” and a stylized “a.” The “a” has a little eagle head in the middle, mirroring the SHIELD logo.

"For anyone who knows the comics, if you look closely at this title design, you’ll see a few clues about where we’re going," Marvel TV head Brad Winderbaum told the audience during the announcement. "I can’t tell you anything else about it yet because it’s a secret. We're going to start casting it in a couple weeks.”

Agents of SHIELD ended back in 2020 and saw Gregg’s Agent Coulson return from beyond the grave in android form. However, the series is not listed on the Disney+ "MCU Complete Timeline" section, which features every single canon MCU movie, TV series, and one-off special, so its place in official Marvel canon is unclear.

articles.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl Paperback Drops to Lowest Price Ever at Amazon
articles.summary: Dungeon Crawler Carl, the hit LitRPG series by Matt Dinniman, has just dropped to its lowest price ever at Amazon (according to the price comparison site CamelCamelCamel ). This is for the paperback copy of the book, which is now available for just $12.48, a sizable drop from its $20 list price.
body: That's just book one in the epic series as well, with every other book also seeing discounts at Amazon right now, alongside being part of the incredible "3 for 2" sale that's ongoing right now.

So, in summary, you've got options! If you want to keep things as affordable as possible, opt for the paperback edition of book one (simply titled Dungeon Crawler Carl), and then add in Carl's Doomsday Scenario (book two) in paperback for $12.98, and The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook (book three) for $17.
Book three is yet to be released in paperback, however, so this is the hardback edition.

While it seems a shame to miss out on a free edition of the book series, if you are a purist and want your book collection to match (i.e. all paperback or hardback), then you can either opt for the more expensive hardback editions, or simply sub in another item to get for free in the "3 for 2" sale.

Producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura - a former Warner Bros. exec influential in signing the The Matrix and Harry Potter films, and known for producing the Transformers films - is said to be attached to the project, with CD Projekt Red collaborating.
The report comes from Deadline, though the publication had no further information to share than what's above. We've asked CD Projekt Red for comment.

Believing that CD Projekt Red would venture into live-action film territory doesn't take a stretch of the imagination. The first season, released in 2022, was "fantastic", Wes wrote in his Cyberpunk Edgerunners impressions article, and amassed considerable Netflix viewing figures.

articles.title: Everything To Know About the PUBG MOBILE Brainrot Royale Pumpkin-themed Update
articles.summary: It’s October, which means two things: spooky season is here, and it’s time to celebrate. That’s something PUBG MOBILE knows all too well, because going live today is a brand new pumpkin-themed makeover to Brainrot Royale in Version 4.6.
body: Things get eerie with the epic new Ghost Ship, a new timed event that alternates with the Boss Room. When the event begins, a gigantic ship emerges from the mist and sails into the centre of the level, where it periodically locks onto Brainrots travelling along the conveyor belt and fires tracking Ghost Bullets at them. Those tracking bullets select their target, and if there’s a hit, then the Brainrot mutates into a Pumpkin Brainrot, a special Version 4.6-limited tier that’s yours for the taking. You can also collect Pumpkin Brainrot by smashing the Pumpkin Eggs found in the Boss Room. You can take them back to your base, or perhaps steal them from someone else. The choice is yours.

That’s not all the Ghost Ship event offers. Special updrafts occur during the event, which permit players to fly up onto the ship’s deck. It’s there they will discover the Pirate Captain’s Shop. In it, great booty awaits in the form of limited items and rewards. To get all that pirate plunder, you’ll need to get Pirate Coins.

articles.title: After Going Hands-On With the New Marvel Comics App, I Still Don't Know Why Unlimited Had to Die
articles.summary: Earlier this week, Marvel announced that it was discontinuing the Marvel Unlimited app, only to have it replaced by the new Marvel Comics app, powered by Webtoon. At New York Comic Con I had the chance to go hands-on with the app, and I am struggling to see why it needs to exist.
body: Just like Marvel Unlimited, the new Marvel Comics app will bring the entire Marvel and Star Wars comics libraries at both of its subscription tiers. On the surface, the big advantage Webtoon has over Unlimited is how quickly new comics will be available — with the more expensive ‘Ultimate’ tier getting new issues 30 days after print, rather than Unlimited’s 90 day waiting period.

Webtoon shared a rough roadmap for the app; it’s looking to bring in Disney and Pixar comics, make it easier to create your own custom lists, and create different profiles for all the comics readers in your home – even kids. But, Webtoon failed to share dates for when any of these improvements are coming, so at least for now, it looks like the bulk of the changes are minor cosmetic ones.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered's New Patch Adds Highly Requested Graphics Fix
articles.summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered hasn't been out for more than two weeks, and it's already received a handful of hotfixes and patches. This is normal for an upgrade that was conceived to reward longtime fans of the series by granting them a better experience with the game.
body: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered made improvements that affected all aspects of the beloved RPG. While the visual enhancements were obvious, players noticed the environment looked off — washed out, many would say. They quickly realized it was an issue with the bloom setting, which is a visual effect that's supposed to improve lighting. A full list of the changes and fixes is available here.
CD Projekt Red was quick to act. Update 5.01 made adjustments to bloom as well as ray tracing, path tracing, character lighting, and tone mapping.

Players who don't want bloom enabled at all can now toggle it off in settings. Light shafts and depth of field can also be modified. These customization features were previously available on PC but not on consoles. Thanks to optimizations that were made with this patch, performance has also been improved. From now on, console players will experience a visually enhanced Witcher 3 Remastered. PC users saw graphic fixes made to dynamic resolution scaling.
points: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered hasn't been out for more than two weeks, and it's already received a handful of hotfixes and patches.
This is normal for an upgrade that was conceived to reward longtime fans of the series by granting them a better experience with the game.

articles.title: The Boys Creator's Next Project Promises to Be Pure Torture
articles.summary: If you thought The Boys creator Garth Ennis was done getting his hands dirty with blood and violence, think again. Ennis and director Rob Jabbaz ( The Sadness ) have teamed up to bring one of the most wicked comic tales ever, Crossed, to the silver screen.
body: A new teaser trailer, exclusively revealed by Bloody Disgusting, is now available on YouTube.

As comic fans, we know some comics are unlikely to get an adaptation, either because the format suits comic books best or because of heavy subject matter. That's why it's easy to be surprised when something as depraved as Crossed gets an adaptation.

Produced by Los Angeles company Six Studios, Crossed follows a group of strangers as they head north to escape the infected known only as the Crossed. However, instead of being lumbering, zombie-like figures, the Crossed are affected by a mysterious disease that causes a red cross to appear on their foreheads and encourages their worst impulses. Think of it almost as an intrusive thought — only this time, it's impossible to ignore. Rape, murder, and other atrocities, the Crossed follow that impulse to sate their pleasure and move on to the next urge.
points: If you thought The Boys creator Garth Ennis was done getting his hands dirty with blood and violence, think again.
Ennis and director Rob Jabbaz ( The Sadness ) have teamed up to bring one of the most wicked comic tales ever, Crossed, to the silver screen.

articles.title: WoW: Forever's list of changes snowballed as Blizzard got more excited, says dev: 'Our original pitch internally was: We'll do 4 new dungeons'
articles.summary: Questing through the World of Warcraft: Forever beta, I've been impressed by just how much has been layered on top of the game's Classic world—new quests and new dungeons, designed to slot in seamlessly to the more oldschool playstyle without causing too much friction.
body: Talking to associate production director Clay Stone, Forever initially had far more humble beginnings: "It's been an evolution, and I think that's probably pretty clear from all the classic titles we've done so far in the level of experimentation and breaking away from #NoChanges at the beginning."

"Obviously, with that, it was a wonderful testing ground for us to be able to see what the limits were and what what players would accept as [something that] does or does not fit into the space, how classes could function, and certainly for us as a team, wonderful opportunities for us to be able to learn how to develop things or new content in that vanilla era space."

Said version apparently snowballed the more excited the developers became, says Stone: "There is a version of WoW Forever that really is that version of Vanilla with just a couple slight class changes. We give paladins a taunt, and presto change-o, you got Classic Plus or WoW forever … Our original pitch internally was: We'll do four new dungeons, and the next thing we know, we're doing six, and the next thing we know, we're doing nine.

articles.title: Forget the Weeping Angels, This WW2 Episode Is the Scariest 'Doctor' Who Has Ever Been
articles.summary: Russell T. Davies had a lot to prove when the BBC put him in charge of giving Doctor Who a new lease of life after the 16-year gap between Classic Who in 1989 and New Who, which launched in 2005.
body: Coming hot on the heels of the Time War, Davies introduced a darker Doctor (played by Christopher Eccleston), struggling with the grief of being the last of the Time Lords. This grimmer slant didn’t just extend to our favorite alien but to the episodes themselves—including one that haunts me (and everyone who grew up watching New Who) to this day.

“The Empty Child” has many iconic parts surrounding its conception. It introduced one of the Doctor’s most rakish companions, a lovable con man from the 51st century known as Captain Jack Harkness (John Barrowman), and it was also the first Doctor Who episode Steven Moffat wrote; he would later take over from Davies as Doctor Who ’s showrunner in 2010.
However, the most important thing about “The Empty Child” is this: It is, without a doubt, the scariest episode of Doctor Who’s first season (along with its follow-up, “The Doctor Dances”).

articles.title: Crunchyroll goes all in on webtoons: Every anime announcement from New York Comic Con
articles.summary: New York Comic Con 2026 was packed with news and exciting announcements from the entertainment world. While many eyes were set on the Marvel panel to catch the latest updates on the always-evolving state of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, anime had a strong presence too.
body: During the Crunchyroll Showcase panel, the company presented a packed lineup that included anime, theatrical projects, manga, and more. One of the highlights was the announcement of a partnership with Hayate, a Japanese anime production company established by Aniplex, and Line Digital Frontier Corporation, a subsidiary of Webtoon Entertainment. The three companies will work together to develop anime adaptations of approximately 15 popular webtoons available through Line Digital Frontier's mobile application. The first three titles in the lineup were presented during the panel, with some exciting trailers already available to watch.

Webtoons have become a very popular form of entertainment in the past few years. Series published on platforms like Line, Webtoon, and KakaoPage accumulate millions of views, boosting global fandoms eager for animated adaptations. The success of the Solo Leveling anime, adapted from a web novel and webcomic published on KakaoPage, made the industry aware of the potential of these IPs.

articles.title: Intel to release new CPUs on old socket in early 2027 says Gigabyte - memory crisis making DDR4 desirable again
articles.summary: Gigabyte is readying its B760 and H610 motherboards for new LGA1700 processors. Wait, what year is it? "Built on socket LGA1700 and expected to launch in early 2027," Gigabyte says in a post on its website, "the new processors bring fresh performance to an established platform, and Gigabyte users…
body: These are new LGA1700 chips. We're talking about fresh spins on Raptor Lake and Arrow Lake here, which previously made up the 12th/13th/14th Gen, and were last released as a major launch in 2023. That's a long time ago in CPU land. We've had two consecutive launches since, in Arrow Lake and the Arrow Lake refresh, neither of which dented AMD's stranglehold on the enthusiast market with its X3D chips.
So what chance do these old chips have of selling anything? Quite a good one, actually, as these old chips still support DDR4 memory.
DDR4 memory is currently a lot cheaper than DDR5 memory. We've seen big price hikes on both, but you can grab a DDR4-3600 32 GB kit for around $210 and a DDR5-6000 32 GB kit for $480. Ouch.
"LGA1700 is still a good socket. Lots of people [are] still interested in DDR4, so [we’ll] keep offering, and you'll see [pricing] smooth out over time. It'll come back to normal. That's the plan."

articles.title: Peter Molyneux explains the origin story of Black & White's famous creatures: 'It was originally a monster. It wasn't a cute creature'
articles.summary: Recently, I travelled to Guildford to interview Peter Molyneux, the father of the god game genre, about his final game, Masters of Albion, which just got a major, game-changing update.
body: I've been a long-term fan of Molyneux's games, though, stretching all the way back to Theme Park, so I also took this opportunity to also ask the legendary game dev about, arguably, his most famous god game creation to date, Black & White.

And, specifically, I wanted to know where the origin of Black & White's most famous creations came from: the titanic animal creatures that you, as god, nurture in the game and use as an instrument of your will. And, well, the story of how these creatures came to be is interesting.

Molyneux's core strength, to me at least, has always been his uncontainable and seemingly endless creativity. The ability to dream up new games and features has led the legendary dev to create some of PC gaming's most iconic titles, including Populous, Theme Park, Dungeon Keeper, Black & White, and Fable. Yes, sure, implementing all those ideas perfectly has been a recurring challenge, but it's great to see Molyneux returning to the god game genre one more time before he bows out to try and pull many of his greatest hits ideas together in one god game package.

articles.title: Timeloop metroidvania Echo Weaver is the brave game that locks almost nothing off and challenges you to break it
articles.summary: Writing about new 2D timeloop metroidvania Echo Weaver is tricky because most - possibly all - of what you need to complete it is available to you the very second you first wake up, deep in the charnelpools of an ethereal and shattered lunar civilisation.
body: The plot in brief: you are a perpetually rewinding robot boy on a mission to work out what the hell happened. You'll explore overgrown biomes, investigate busted machines, run errands for a handful of scrappy, splashy-hued aliens, and conjure holographic flashbacks that cover the circumstances of your own creation. Developers Moonlight Kids stress that the only thing you really gain in the course of all this is knowledge. There are a few upgrades to gather, but no core skills to unlock. Instead, it's all there for you to learn, whether by reaching a tutorial area or just by hitting buttons at random and messing with terrain fixtures.

As such, my telling you about abilities really does risk ruining it, much like explaining the behaviour of celestial bodies in Echo Weaver's great influence, Outer Wilds. So if you're strongly inclined to buy the game – my verdict after four hours: a vivid and thoughtful, freeform Metroidy puzzler with refreshingly minimal combat and a few rough edges - maybe get your feet wet before reading on.
Still here? Right then, let's reset the loop and take things from the top.

articles.title: Ben Affleck Has Some Strong Opinions About Fortnite Skins And How Hard The Game Is For Him
articles.summary: Have you ever wondered what two-time Oscar-winner Ben Affleck thinks about Fortnite skins, and the game generally? You can now rest easy, as the man himself has weighed in with some strong takes.
body: Appearing on the New Heights podcast with brothers Jason and Travis Kelce, Affleck said he's a big gamer, and is particularly fond of first-person shooter games, so when he tried Fortnite, he thought he'd hold his own. That wasn't the case, though. He said not only did he get wiped out immediately, but the 12-year-olds he was playing against made fun of him after taking him out.
Affleck said he got heated and shouted back at the kids: "I don't suck! I'm a grown man!"

Affleck also told a brief story about how his son wanted Fortnite skins for Christmas, and he was shocked to learn the specific skins his son wanted cost hundreds of dollars. "They ain't even real? Just to wear in the game? That's bullsh**," Affleck said.
Affleck is a big fan of the competitive shooter Valorant. In the movie Gone Girl, Affleck's character can be seen playing Battlefield 3.

articles.title: Ubisoft Shutting Down Rainbow Six Mobile After Less Than A Year
articles.summary: Ubisoft has announced that Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down, and it didn't have a very long life. The game soft-launched in 2023, but properly rolled out for everyone back in February 2026.
body: "'We are proud of the passion, creativity, and dedication our team has put into the game," Ubisoft said. "One of the greatest parts of this adventure has been getting to experience it alongside you. We've loved seeing the memes, videos, strategies, tournaments, impossible plays, and all the countless moments that happened because you were here."

The developers are going to move on to "other long-term strategic projects," but Ubisoft did not say what these may be. The studio will share more details on the game's final days in the coming weeks.
"We are truly grateful to everyone who has played our game," the developers said.

Rainbow Six Mobile pitched itself as a mobile version of the extremely popular Rainbow Six Siege, which continues to crush it more than a decade after release. The next Rainbow Six game is Rainbow Six Tactics, and it's coming next year.

videos.title: The Secret Combat Detail Phantom Blade 0 Kept From Us
videos.summary: After my six hours of hands-on time with Phantom Blade 0 in LA, I was sold on the game. The boss design is amazing, the soundtrack is killer, and the beautiful wide linear environments have great metroidvania style side distractions.
body: Obviously, the crown jewel of developer S-Game's production is the motion-captured martial arts combat, and it did not disappoint. But as I kept fighting, something unique and unexpected stood out to me and, after having a talk with director and CEO Soulframe Liang, who confirmed what I experienced, I now better understand what S-Game is trying to accomplish.
